decisions.reason: The evening psychiatric day-patient program sits squarely in the firm's strongest therapeutic knowledge base, so its existing mental-health expertise and own R&D make continued refinement and retention very likely.
Outpatient sociotherapy is closely related to the firm's established support services, giving it strong absorptive capacity to read demand, adapt the offer, and keep it in the portfolio.

The retail shop still fits the firm's inclusion and sheltered-workshop capabilities, but because retailing is more peripheral than core care services it remains the most exposed current product if resources need refocusing.

Meal delivery for seniors is adjacent to the firm's eldercare activities and can draw on its service network, though the newer launch and added logistical demands make it less secure than its core therapeutic offers.
